program.section_heading: English for Multilingual Students Introduction Certificate of Competency
outcomes: Upon completion the student will be able to respond to a given topic to write one or more well-organized paragraphs using a topic sentence, relevant details, and a concluding sentence.
Upon completion the student will be able to analyze the relationship among ideas in adapted reading passages.
Upon completion the student will be able to participate in individual and group oral presentations, class discussions, and social discourse.
